title: Coolant Flush
summary: Maintenance blueprint for checking coolant age, contamination, freeze protection, and cooling-system condition before flushing or refilling.
symptoms: Coolant service interval due or unknown coolant history
Rusty, dirty, weak, mixed, or contaminated coolant
Weak heat after prior cooling work or trapped air suspicion
Cooling repair completed and refill quality needs to be controlled
inspect_first: Coolant level, color, odor, freeze protection, and contamination signs
Radiator cap, reservoir, hoses, clamps, thermostat housing, and water pump seepage
Oil/coolant mixing, combustion gas suspicion, or heavy rust before simple service
Bleed points, coolant specification, capacity, and air-bleed procedure
repair_overview: Confirm coolant type, service interval, and whether contamination requires diagnosis first.
Inspect for leaks and pressure-test when coolant loss or residue is present.
Drain or exchange coolant using the appropriate service method.
Refill with correct coolant mix and bleed air from the system.
Verify heat output, operating temperature, fan behavior, and final coolant level.
common_mistakes: Flushing coolant before checking for head gasket, oil cooler, or transmission cooler contamination
Ignoring leaks that will lower coolant level after the customer leaves
estimate_guidance: Use coolant service as maintenance only when contamination does not point to a larger fault.
Add pressure testing when coolant loss, smell, residue, or overheating is present.
Include bleed time and correct coolant type in the estimate note.
Recommend hose, cap, thermostat, or water pump repairs only when inspection supports them.

recommended_repairs.title: Coolant Leak Diagnosis
recommended_repairs.description: Use when coolant level is low, residue is visible, or pressure loss is suspected.

recommended_repairs.title: Radiator Hose Inspection
recommended_repairs.description: Commonly checked when coolant age, swelling, softness, or leaks are concerns.

recommended_repairs.title: Thermostat Replacement
recommended_repairs.description: Related when warm-up behavior or temperature control evidence points beyond fluid condition.

diagnostic_context.intro: Coolant service should start with condition, contamination, and leak checks so maintenance does not cover up a cooling-system fault.
